title: Run a BTM optimization subflow from master-provided PV, tariff, and load paths
summary: Execute a behind-the-meter (BTM) energy storage optimization workflow that accepts master-flow file path inputs for PV, tariff/rate, and load data, builds BTM request objects and ESS parameters, runs the BTM optimizer with a selected solver, and saves result CSVs plus checkpoint paths.

task.description: Behind-the-meter energy storage optimization workflow that passes master-flow file path inputs for PV, tariff/rate, and load data into a BTM subflow, runs the subflow, and returns saved result locations and checkpoints.
task.pinned_context_summary: Subflow name: btm_flow_2026_new. The workflow uses BTM-specific classes BtmDMS and BtmOptimizerHandler in a BTM app environment. Master-provided inputs are the PV path, rate path, and load path. Default local inputs include data_path='/data/', power=100, energy=400, rte=0.88, solver_name='glpk', and results directory './results/workspace'. The rate file is expected to be JSON, and solved outputs are exported as CSV files.

expected_inputs.name: pv_path
expected_inputs.description: Path to the PV profile input file passed from the master flow.

expected_inputs.name: rate_path
expected_inputs.description: Path to the tariff or rate structure JSON file passed from the master flow.

expected_inputs.name: load_path
expected_inputs.description: Path to the load profile input file passed from the master flow.

expected_inputs.name: data_path
expected_inputs.description: Home/data directory used to initialize the BTM data manager and persist intermediate data.

expected_inputs.name: power
expected_inputs.description: ESS power rating used in the optimization parameter set.

expected_inputs.name: energy
expected_inputs.description: ESS energy capacity used in the optimization parameter set.

expected_inputs.name: rte
expected_inputs.description: Round-trip efficiency for the ESS parameter set.

expected_inputs.name: solver_name
expected_inputs.description: Optimization solver name supported by the BTM environment, such as glpk.

expected_inputs.name: results_location
expected_inputs.description: Directory where solved operation result CSV files will be written.

plan.workflow_strategy: Use the BTM tool workflow pattern rather than a generic Python pattern: ingest file paths for load, PV, and tariff data; convert them into BTM-compatible profile and rate objects; assemble ESS parameters and an optimization request; initialize a BTM data manager and optimizer handler; solve with the configured solver; then persist each solved operation result to a results directory and return saved file locations as checkpoints. Treat the master flow as the source of the three external data paths while keeping storage parameters, solver choice, and output directory configurable within the subflow or by extension from the master flow.
step_summary: Accept master-flow inputs for PV path, rate/tariff path, and load path.
Create a BTM data manager rooted at the configured data directory.
Wrap the load file path into a load profile descriptor.
Wrap the PV file path into a PV profile descriptor.
Load the tariff/rate JSON file into a rate structure object.
Build ESS parameter settings from power, energy, and round-trip efficiency inputs.
Assemble a BTM optimization request from rate structure, PV profile, load profile, and ESS parameters.
Run the BTM optimizer handler with the selected solver and data manager.
Save each solved operation result as a CSV in the configured results directory.
Return the saved results directory and a checkpoint mapping of generated files.

criteria: The subflow receives non-empty master inputs for pv_path, rate_path, and load_path.
The rate JSON loads successfully without parse errors.
The BTM data manager initializes successfully using the configured data_path.
The optimizer handler runs without solver or environment errors and returns solved operations plus handler status.
At least one result CSV is written to the configured results directory when solved operations are returned.
The workflow returns both saved_location and a checkpoints mapping keyed by generated file paths.
Saved CSV filenames are sanitized and valid on the target filesystem.

limitations: This skill is specific to the QuESt BTM tool and depends on BTM classes and environment availability.
The workflow assumes the tariff input is JSON; other tariff formats require preprocessing.
The PV and load preparation steps only wrap file paths into descriptors and do not validate file contents themselves.
Default ESS settings include fixed transformer rating and state-of-charge bounds; these may not suit all projects.
Solver support is limited to solvers installed and configured in the BTM environment.
The recorded workflow exposes saved result locations and checkpoints but does not include downstream analysis or visualization of the optimization outputs.
